title: Front O2 Sensor Inversion / Slow Response
meaning: Mazda SkyActiv / MZR PCM detected that the upstream Air/Fuel ratio sensor output did not invert or respond within the target feedback period during closed-loop operation.
inspectionSteps: Inspect upstream A/F sensor wiring harness near exhaust heat shield.
Check for exhaust manifold crack near sensor bung.
Monitor live A/F lambda equivalence ratio.
verifiedFixes: Replace Upstream Air/Fuel Ratio Sensor (Mazda OEM recommended)
Clean throttle body and perform idle relearn

title: Post-Catalyst Fuel Trim System Too Lean (Bank 1)
meaning: Downstream heated O2 sensor fuel trim correction has reached maximum lean limit on Mazda SkyActiv-G powertrain.
inspectionSteps: Check for exhaust leak between catalytic converter and rear O2 sensor.
Inspect intake boots for minor unmetered air.
Verify rear O2 sensor heater circuit resistance.
verifiedFixes: Tighten exhaust flange bolts / replace midpipe gasket

title: ECM/PCM Engine Off Timer Performance
meaning: PCM internal soak/off-timer failed plausibility comparison against instrument cluster clock during engine-off period. Common on Gen 7 BP/DM models after battery disconnect.
inspectionSteps: Verify 12V battery terminal clamp tightness and battery health.
Check for aftermarket battery maintainers or dashcams drawing power while parked.
Clear code and complete standard 15-minute key-off soak test.
verifiedFixes: Reprogram PCM with latest calibration update (Mazda TSB 01-008/21)

title: Active Grille Air Shutter 'A' Stuck
meaning: The PCM commanded the active aerodynamic grille shutter (AGS) actuator to open or close, but mechanical position feedback indicated an obstructed or jammed vane.
symptoms: Slight increase in highway coolant temp or aerodynamic drag
inspectionSteps: Inspect lower front bumper grille louvers for road debris, ice, or pebbles wedging the blades.
Unplug AGS actuator harness and check for moisture or bent pins.
Gently cycle shutter blades by hand with ignition off to check for mechanical binding.
verifiedFixes: Dislodge road debris/pebbles jamming grille shutter blades
Replace Active Grille Air Shutter actuator assembly

title: Control Module Communication Bus 'A' Off
meaning: Mazda HS-CAN or MS-CAN network controller entered bus-off state due to excessive transmission error frames.
inspectionSteps: Inspect OBD-II port wiring and any attached accessories/dongles.
Check battery state of charge (SkyActiv requires >12.4V resting).
Inspect CAN terminal resistance at DLC pins 6 & 14.
verifiedFixes: Remove incompatible or shorting OBD-II accessories
Inspect harness near front bumper / radar sensor

title: TPMS Event Information / Sensor Missing
meaning: Mazda BCM/TPMS module failed to receive RF radio packet from one or more direct wheel tire pressure sensors within timeout.
symptoms: TPMS light solid or flashing for 1 minute on startup
inspectionSteps: Check tire pressures on all four wheels with manual gauge.
Check if aftermarket wheels without TPMS sensors are mounted.
Use 315MHz/433MHz TPMS tool to check wheel sensor battery life.
verifiedFixes: Perform Mazda TPMS relearn procedure (drive >15 mph for 10 mins)
Replace dead internal coin battery in tire sensor / replace sensor

title: Steering Wheel Position Sensor Plausibility
meaning: ABS/DSC module detected variance between steering angle sensor rate-of-turn and lateral accelerometer during G-Vectoring Control (GVC) calculation.
inspectionSteps: Verify wheel alignment (center steering wheel on straight road).
Check front wheel speed sensor wiring and tire circumference consistency.
Perform steering angle zero-point calibration.
verifiedFixes: Perform wheel alignment and steering angle sensor center-calibration
Clean front wheel speed sensor reluctor teeth
